Summary: This code fragment processes a UTF-16 encoded string, converting it to a UTF-8 representation while handling endianness based on the `unicode_type` variable.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: None

Logic: The code begins by checking the endianness of the input based on the `unicode_type`. If it is big-endian, it processes the string differently than if it is little-endian. It swaps pairs of characters in the `szLine` array until it reaches the end of the string.
rationale: Both implementations perform the same defensive check for the end of the string by checking for a null byte pair. There is no evidence of a missing guard in either side.
